I'm now revising the UI. I will remove the ESP32-specific settings and concentrate on Start/Stop controls for the Firebase stream. The data structure will include emotion, confidence, and timestamp fields from the Raspberry Pi. I've realized I need to adapt my approach based on the specific environment of this prompt. I've noted that I can't "install" packages here, so I'll need to use a CDN or assume the user has a setup. 😠 angry
